integrity: General claim proved by explicit Fourier matrix units and Frobenius descent; finite checker illustrates, but does not exhaust, all parameter choices. No independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Coefficient field characteristic must be coprime to the order of the underlying finite abelian group. Both the Alexander parameter and its complement must be automorphisms. Prior complex multiplicity-freeness is acknowledged, not presented as new. Modular affine-group representation results may contain equivalent formulations.
title: Finite-field Wedderburn blocks of left multiplication envelopes of Latin Alexander quandle algebras
